WITH lead_base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM staging.stg_salesforce__lead
    WHERE is_deleted = FALSE
),
lead_scored AS (
    SELECT
        lead_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        CASE
            WHEN first_name IS NOT NULL AND last_name IS NOT NULL
                THEN first_name || ' ' || last_name
            WHEN last_name IS NOT NULL THEN last_name
            ELSE NULL
        END AS lead_name,
        company,
        email,
        phone,
        mobile_phone,
        lead_source,
        status,
        industry,
        annual_revenue,
        number_of_employees,
        is_converted,
        converted_date,
        converted_account_id,
        converted_contact_id,
        converted_opportunity_id,
        owner_id,
        created_date,
        CASE
            WHEN created_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN is_converted AND converted_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN is_converted THEN DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(created_date AS DATE), CAST(converted_date AS DATE))
            ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE)
        END AS lead_age_days,
        CASE
            WHEN is_converted AND created_date IS NOT NULL AND converted_date IS NOT NULL
                THEN DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(created_date AS DATE), CAST(converted_date AS DATE))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS conversion_time_days,
        CASE
            WHEN lead_source IS NULL THEN 'Other'
            WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'web')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'online')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'social')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'search') THEN 'Digital'
            WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'referral')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'partner')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'word') THEN 'Referral'
            WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'trade')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'event')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'conference')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'campaign') THEN 'Marketing'
            WHEN CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'phone')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'call')
                OR CONTAINS(LOWER(lead_source), 'direct') THEN 'Direct'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS lead_source_category,
        CAST(
            (CASE WHEN email IS NOT NULL AND POSITION('@' IN email) > 0
                    AND POSITION('.' IN SUBSTRING(email, POSITION('@' IN email) + 1)) > 0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN (phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone) <> '')
                    OR (mobile_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(mobile_phone) <> '') THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN industry IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(industry) <> '' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN annual_revenue > 0 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN number_of_employees > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(lead_source)) IN ('referral', 'website', 'partner referral') THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN company IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(company) <> ''
                    AND NOT REGEXP_MATCHES(LOWER(company), 'test|example|demo') THEN 10 ELSE 0 END)
            AS INTEGER
        ) AS lead_quality_score,
        CASE
            WHEN is_converted = TRUE
                AND NULLIF(TRIM(converted_account_id), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(TRIM(converted_contact_id), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(TRIM(converted_opportunity_id), '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_complete_conversion
    FROM lead_base
),
lead_categorized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN conversion_time_days IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN conversion_time_days <= 7 THEN 'Fast Track'
            WHEN conversion_time_days <= 30 THEN 'Standard'
            WHEN conversion_time_days <= 90 THEN 'Slow'
            ELSE 'Extended'
        END AS conversion_speed_category,
        CASE
            WHEN lead_quality_score >= 80 THEN 'Hot'
            WHEN lead_quality_score >= 60 THEN 'Warm'
            WHEN lead_quality_score >= 40 THEN 'Cool'
            ELSE 'Cold'
        END AS lead_temperature
    FROM lead_scored
)
SELECT
    lead_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    lead_name,
    company,
    email,
    phone,
    mobile_phone,
    lead_source,
    status,
    industry,
    annual_revenue,
    number_of_employees,
    is_converted,
    converted_date,
    converted_account_id,
    converted_contact_id,
    converted_opportunity_id,
    owner_id,
    created_date,
    lead_age_days,
    conversion_time_days,
    lead_source_category,
    lead_quality_score,
    has_complete_conversion,
    conversion_speed_category,
    lead_temperature
FROM lead_categorized

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel
      description: Lead conversion metrics and funnel attributes derived from non-deleted Salesforce leads
      grain: One row per lead_id from non-deleted staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__lead
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_salesforce__lead and keep only records where is_deleted is false; emit each remaining source row without aggregation or deduplication. - Pass through source attributes and derive: - lead_name: If both first_name and last_name are present, set to "first_name last_name"; if only last_name is present, set to last_name; otherwise null. Exactly one space is inserted when both are present; original casing is preserved. - lead_age_days: For converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and converted_date; for non-converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and the current date at execution. If a required date is missing, the result is null. Time-of-day is ignored. - conversion_time_days: For converted leads only, the number of days between the date parts of created_date and converted_date; null otherwise or when dates are missing. Time-of-day is ignored. - lead_source_category: Categorize lead_source using case-insensitive substring matches in this order: Digital if it contains web/online/social/search; Referral if it contains referral/partner/word; Marketing if it contains trade/event/conference/campaign; Direct if it contains phone/call/direct; otherwise Other. Null lead_source is treated as Other. - lead_quality_score: Integer score (0–100) computed as the sum of points: +20 for an email containing "@" and a later ".", +15 if phone or mobile_phone is present, +10 if industry is non-empty after trimming, +15 if annual_revenue is greater than 0, +10 if number_of_employees is greater than 0, +20 if lead_source equals referral, website, or partner referral (case-insensitive), and +10 if company is non-empty after trimming and does not contain test/example/demo (case-insensitive). - has_complete_conversion: True only when is_converted is true and all of converted_account_id, converted_contact_id, and converted_opportunity_id are present; otherwise false. - conversion_speed_category: For converted leads with a non-null conversion_time_days, assign Fast Track for <=7 days, Standard for <=30 days, Slow for <=90 days, and Extended for >90 days; otherwise null. - lead_temperature: Hot for scores >=80, Warm for >=60, Cool for >=40, else Cold. - Output exactly the selected pass-through and derived columns; no additional filtering or ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: lead_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique lead identifier from source
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name from source
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name from source
      - name: lead_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Display name: ''first_name last_name'' when both are present, last_name when only last_name is present, otherwise null; preserves original casing'
      - name: company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name; used in scoring after trimming and case-insensitive checks to exclude test/example/demo
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email address; adds to score when it contains '@' and a later '.'
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary phone; adds to score when present
      - name: mobile_phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mobile phone; adds to score when present
      - name: lead_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead source; used for categorization and scoring with case-insensitive comparisons
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead status from source
      - name: industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Industry; treated as present for scoring when trimmed value is non-empty
      - name: annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Annual revenue; adds +15 to score when greater than zero; null yields 0 points
      - name: number_of_employees
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Employee count; adds +10 to score when greater than zero; null yields 0 points
      - name: is_converted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Conversion flag controlling age, conversion time, completeness, and speed category
      - name: converted_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Conversion timestamp; date part used for age and conversion time
      - name: converted_account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: converted_contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: converted_opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity ID created on conversion; must be present with others for complete conversion
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lead owner ID from source
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp; date part used for age and conversion time
      - name: lead_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Age in days: converted leads use days between created and converted dates; non-converted use days between created date and the run''s current date; null if a required date is missing; time-of-day ignored'
      - name: conversion_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from creation to conversion only for converted leads; null otherwise or if dates are missing; time-of-day ignored
      - name: lead_source_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Case-insensitive substring match with ordered precedence: Digital (web, online, social, search) > Referral (referral, partner, word) > Marketing (trade, event, conference, campaign) > Direct (phone, call, direct) > Other; null lead_source yields Other'
      - name: lead_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '0–100 integer score summed from conditions: email pattern ''@'' before ''.'', phone or mobile present, trimmed industry non-empty, annual revenue > 0, employees > 0, lead_source equals referral/website/partner referral (case-insensitive), company trimmed non-empty and does not include test/example/demo (case-insensitive)'
      - name: has_complete_conversion
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when converted and all three converted IDs are present; false otherwise
      - name: conversion_speed_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For converted leads with conversion_time_days: Fast Track (<=7), Standard (<=30), Slow (<=90), Extended (>90); null for non-converted or when conversion_time_days is null'
      - name: lead_temperature
        data_type: VARCHAR

specification.name: int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel
specification.description: Lead conversion metrics and funnel attributes derived from non-deleted Salesforce leads
specification.grain: One row per lead_id from non-deleted staging.stg_salesforce__lead
specification.business_logic: - Start from staging.stg_salesforce__lead and keep only records where is_deleted is false; emit each remaining source row without aggregation or deduplication. - Pass through source attributes and derive: - lead_name: If both first_name and last_name are present, set to "first_name last_name"; if only last_name is present, set to last_name; otherwise null. Exactly one space is inserted when both are present; original casing is preserved. - lead_age_days: For converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and converted_date; for non-converted leads, the number of days between the date part of created_date and the current date at execution. If a required date is missing, the result is null. Time-of-day is ignored. - conversion_time_days: For converted leads only, the number of days between the date parts of created_date and converted_date; null otherwise or when dates are missing. Time-of-day is ignored. - lead_source_category: Categorize lead_source using case-insensitive substring matches in this order: Digital if it contains web/online/social/search; Referral if it contains referral/partner/word; Marketing if it contains trade/event/conference/campaign; Direct if it contains phone/call/direct; otherwise Other. Null lead_source is treated as Other. - lead_quality_score: Integer score (0–100) computed as the sum of points: +20 for an email containing "@" and a later ".", +15 if phone or mobile_phone is present, +10 if industry is non-empty after trimming, +15 if annual_revenue is greater than 0, +10 if number_of_employees is greater than 0, +20 if lead_source equals referral, website, or partner referral (case-insensitive), and +10 if company is non-empty after trimming and does not contain test/example/demo (case-insensitive). - has_complete_conversion: True only when is_converted is true and all of converted_account_id, converted_contact_id, and converted_opportunity_id are present; otherwise false. - conversion_speed_category: For converted leads with a non-null conversion_time_days, assign Fast Track for <=7 days, Standard for <=30 days, Slow for <=90 days, and Extended for >90 days; otherwise null. - lead_temperature: Hot for scores >=80, Warm for >=60, Cool for >=40, else Cold. - Output exactly the selected pass-through and derived columns; no additional filtering or ordering is applied.

WITH history_rows AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CAST(created_date AS DATE) AS snapshot_date,
        account_name,
        account_source,
        industry,
        annual_revenue,
        number_of_employees,
        owner_id,
        type,
        billing_city,
        billing_state,
        billing_country,
        website,
        rating,
        ownership,
        parent_id,
        last_activity_date,
        created_date
    FROM staging.stg_salesforce__account_history

),

- name: salesforce__account_daily_history
      description: Daily snapshots of Salesforce account history, keeping the latest change per account per calendar day
      grain: One row per account_id per snapshot_date
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_salesforce__account_history
      business_logic: '- Read all records from staging.stg_salesforce__account_history. - Exclude records marked as deleted. - For each account and calendar day (based on the date part of created_date), sort records by created_date in descending order and keep the first record; if multiple records share the exact same created_date within that day, the choice among them is not deterministic. - Define snapshot_date as the calendar date of created_date from the kept record. - All other fields are taken directly from the kept record without transformation or aggregation; data types are preserved and NULLs are retained. - The final result is ordered by account_id and snapshot_date for readability only.'
      columns:

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Salesforce Account ID for the snapshot.
      - name: snapshot_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the kept change for the account; one row per account and date; ties on identical created timestamps that day are non-deterministic.
